articles.title: Did Disney Confirm Avatar 4? James Cameron's Sequel Release Date Is Still Years Away
articles.summary: Is Avatar 4 really happening? The internet is hyped about word that Disney has greenlit the fourth installment in James Cameron's milestone sci-fi franchise. This latest buzz comes from reports on Disney's Upfronts of its upcoming slate of projects, which was previewed during a presentation in Argentina. With Avatar 4 already occupying a release slot, […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Is Avatar 4 really happening? The internet is hyped about word that Disney has greenlit the fourth installment in James Cameron's milestone sci-fi franchise. This latest buzz comes from reports on Disney's Upfronts of its upcoming slate of projects, which was previewed during a presentation in Argentina. With Avatar 4 already occupying a release slot, and Disney now highlighting the film at the Upfronts, some fans have all the evidence they need to jump to the conclusion that production on the film is ready to go.

But is that really the case? There was a lot that seemed to shift after the release of Avatar: Fire and Ash , and the franchise's future has felt far more uncertain. As it stands, there isn't going to be more Avatar for quite a while, even though some of the fourth film is already shot.

Avatar was always planned to be at least a five-film franchise, with Cameron having hired additional stars like Michelle Yeoh ( Blade Runner 2099 ) to join the franchise. Additionally, Cameron used the time during and after shooting Avatar: Fire and Ash to shoot additional scenes for Avatar 4 – specifically the younger cast members like Britain Dalton (Lo'ak), Trinity Jo-Li Bliss (Tuk), and Jack Champion (Spider), who took another step toward becoming the new protagonists of the franchise in the third film. Avatar 4 is said to include a time jump , which will account for how the younger characters inevitably grow and age in the years between Fire and Ash and the fourth film. So Cameron made sure to get any introductory and/or flashback footage in the can while he had the chance.

Thanks to that foresight, Cameron and the cast of the Avatar series have had a well-earned break – at least this year. Earlier this year, Avatar producer Rae Sanchini made it clear that the machine was gearing up again, and that Avatar 4 would be going into production soon .

“Right now we’re figuring out the schedule,” Sanchini told Inverse . “We’re working hard on it right now, budgeting, scheduling, planning, building out our new pipeline for them. As far as we’re concerned, we’re full speed ahead.”

In that same report, however, Sanchini also noted that Avatar 4 's current release date of December 21, 2029, is now "tentative." He described the need for restructuring the production plans and scaling up to meet the demands of the next chapters. Behind the scenes, that mandate for "restructuring" is also said to be Disney putting pressure on the creative team to bring down the massive costs of the films . Each Avatar sequel has seen its budget soar to somewhere between $300-$400 million; even though they both cleared the billion-dollar mark at the box office, Fire and Ash topped out at just under $1.5 billion – a steep drop-off from the second film, The Way of Water, which earned over $2.3 billion.

More importantly, there have been signs of Avatar fatigue, both culturally and creatively. The new generation of viewers hasn't made the films and their lore the kind of cultural staple that the franchise once was. Meanwhile, James Cameron has made no secret that as he's aging, making more Avatar sequels feels less and less like a priority for him, personally.

"There’s been momentum in the Avatar universe for 21 years at this point because we started in 2005,” Cameron said while receiving the 2026 Governor General’s Performing Arts Award. “It’s been kind of an unbroken continuum. So this is the point where I’m looking at the landscape and asking, ‘What are the other stories I want to tell? How many of them do I need to direct myself versus writing and/or producing with other filmmakers?’”

It seems that the big unanswered question that is hanging over the Avatar franchise is not whether it will continue, but whether it will continue with James Cameron at the helm. And if the motion we're seeing is any indication, Disney will be answering that question sometime next year.

Avatar 4 is currently scheduled for December 21, 2029.

articles.title: A Sandlot Star Had The Jokes On Disney World’s ‘Jingle Cruise’ (& It Made My Heart Grow 3 Sizes)
articles.summary: You’re killin’ me, Patrick Renna!
articles.content:
Getting to be a part of a Hallmark movie that intertwines romance and the magic of Walt Disney World is incredibly cool all on its own. However, when you’re Patrick Renna and you get to play Skipper in the 2026 TV schedule's Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True , you also delight in the joke-telling that comes with getting to take over Walt Disney World’s Jingle Cruise.

Now, this was done for the film Holiday Ever After. Its star, Lacey Chabert , has always been a Disney girl, so I get why she’d want to be a part of a project like this. Not only did she get to actually film a movie inside the Magic Kingdom, but she also got to stay at the resort for the entire length of the shoot . And she shared the Disney magic of it all with her co-stars.

While I’ve never gotten to take over an attraction in the theme parks, I have been lucky enough during media events to walk around Disneyland and Disney World in the early morning hours before guests arrive. I even got to take a spin on the Jungle Cruise before opening, after changes had been made to the attraction. I agree with the Dugout Dads star that not only was it absolutely the coolest experience, but also one that I’ll never forget.

articles.title: Pokémon Countdown Ends in Disappointment for Fans Wanting Winds and Waves News
articles.summary: Courtesy of The Pokemon Company The Pokémon series is celebrating its 30th Anniversary this year, but fans expecting information about the next mainline games for this milestone shouldn't hold their breath. A mysterious countdown approaching the exact date that Pokémon turns 30 had fans excited for a possible tease for Pokemon Winds and Waves, with perhaps some gameplay footage, story […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The Pokémon series is celebrating its 30th Anniversary this year, but fans expecting information about the next mainline games for this milestone shouldn't hold their breath. A mysterious countdown approaching the exact date that Pokémon turns 30 had fans excited for a possible tease for Pokemon Winds and Waves , with perhaps some gameplay footage, story details, or maybe even a release window. However, what players ended up getting was something on a much smaller scale, as simply a music video for the Anniversary was all Nintendo provided.

Nintendo hasn't had to build much hype for Pok é mon Winds and Waves , as the expectations for the game are already much higher than Sword , Shield , Scarlet , or Violet in many ways. For starters, this will be the first Pok é mon game to launch on the newer Nintendo Switch 2 console, which boasts far greater visuals and has a greater potential to deliver a more robust 3D Pok é mon title. At the same time, Winds and Waves are the 1 0th Generation of mainline Pok é mon games, marking a huge milestone for the series alongside the 30th Anniversary fans were embracing this year.

The Pokémon X account has been teasing something special for the game's 30th Anniversary for some time, posting images related to it for the last month alongside numbers from the series' National Pokédex. Fans quickly figured out that these Pokédex numbers were the same amount of days leading up to November 30, 2026, the exact day of Pokémon 's Anniversary. This countdown of sorts had no clues relating to what exactly Nintendo would reveal, but it pointed toward something that would be shown off at 2pm UTC on that specific date.

For a long time, fans suspected that this would refer to new Winds and Waves gameplay, with multiple predictions for what content Nintendo might show. Some thought it might be Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire ports for the Switch 2, much like FireRed and LeafGreen , or perhaps even information about the cozy Pokémon Pokopia spin-off. However, another post from the Pokémon X account proved that the countdown was actually leading toward a special music video named "Evergreen," an official song by Official Hige Dandism with an accompanying hand-drawn visual animation.

The post regarding the music video can be seen below, with some other information surrounding it:

A new Pokémon special music video, “Evergreen,” premieres November 30 at 6 a.m. PST! 🎉 Song: “Evergreen” by OFFICIAL HIGE DANDISM Animation: MADHOUSE Director: Naoko Yamada Follow the link and hit “Notify me” 🛎️ https://t.co/uxEsCIkXmb #Pokemon30 #OnwardWithPokemon pic.twitter.com/vjXpj8qRmf

Directed by Naoko Yamada and animated by studio MADHOUSE, this "Evergreen" music video appears to be a charming celebration of the Pokémon series, mirroring the beloved "Acacia" video sung by Bump of Chicken years ago for a similar event. This video is also said by Nintendo to be the end of their "Pokémon to Tsuzuku" series, or "Continuing with Pokémon" program of Anniversary events throughout the year. Despite the intentions behind the video, fans who were expecting more information about Pokémon Winds and Waves have expressed negative reactions to this reveal, with many being let down at the countdown leading to something not related to game content.

Even our own guesses here at ComicBook were pretty far off from the actual 30th Anniversary content Pokémon is creating at the end of November 2026. Many fans are understandably frustrated with Pokémon not so much for having what appears to be a well-made music video, but for dragging players along for a reveal that seemed grander than the actual result. No ports or new Winds and Waves news means that anything interesting for Pokémon 's gameplay side may be further off than anyone expected, with The Pokémon Company simply taking longer to develop titles or releases of any kind.

Although waiting for Pokémon Winds and Waves is something fans have accepted, the lack of new information since the three starters tease is concerning. At the same time, the fact that Nintendo seemed to mislead players with this Anniversary countdown has only brought concerns up even more, as it suggests they don't have much to show. By highlighting a music video rather than Winds and Waves gameplay, players are worried that the 10th Generation games are taking longer to develop than expected, perhaps pushing back a release date to a far-away window.

Once again, this could be a blessing in disguise, as developers take more time to refine the next Pokémon games into the best versions of themselves. Yet, masking any kind of delay with false promises of something important for the series' Anniversary is more harmful than good in the grand scheme. Even if the music video for Pokémon 's 30th Anniversary is well received, the fact that it was the subject of a continual countdown suggested it was something with greater weight, making it no wonder why fans are disappointed.

What do you think about the music video for Pokémon 's 30th Anniversary? Let us know in the comments below!

articles.title: Crunchyroll's Hottest Fall 2026 Anime Exposes the Real Problem Behind One-Punch Man
articles.summary: J.C. Staff isn't the problem behind One-Punch Man's disaster, as the studio's latest anime, currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll, is doing wonders with its animation. Fans often blame J.C. Staff for the decline in quality that plagued the second and third seasons of One-Punch Man. While the second season surprised fans with how much worse […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google J.C. Staff isn't the problem behind One-Punch Man 's disaster, as the studio's latest anime, currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll, is doing wonders with its animation. Fans often blame J.C. Staff for the decline in quality that plagued the second and third seasons of One-Punch Man . While the second season surprised fans with how much worse it looked compared to the first, the third season, despite taking six years to arrive, somehow looked even worse. It was natural for fans to point their fingers at the studio in charge. However, J.C. Staff has been making anime for four decades now and has crafted some great-looking series.

The anime proving this is Overgeared , which is currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll. While its earlier episodes already demonstrated that J.C. Staff is more than capable of producing a decent action anime, the latest episode delivered one of the coolest fight sequences of 2026, lasting around six to seven minutes. The animation quality reaches its peak throughout this sequence, delivering the kind of spectacular action usually expected from a high-budget anime movie. So, why couldn't One-Punch Man receive the same treatment ? The answer is actually quite simple: no anime studio cared enough about the One-Punch Man anime, and the blame goes back to Madhouse itself as well.

Madhouse produced the first season of the One-Punch Man anime without a permanent staff allocated to the production, instead relying on a team of freelancers working under director Shingo Natsume. However, the studio didn't continue with the second season because of scheduling conflicts, as the director was tied to several other projects. This eventually led Madhouse to drop the project altogether. The blame ultimately lies with Bandai Namco and the production committee, which wanted to capitalize on the success of the first season without waiting for the original team to return.

This eventually led to J.C. Staff taking over the anime under strict budget and time constraints. This highlights how the disaster of the anime's second season stemmed from the fact that the project was never given priority, with the production committee neither waiting for Madhouse's schedule to align nor giving J.C. Staff enough time or budget. The result was disastrous second and third seasons, both products of a production that was never given enough care. With the emergence of Overgeared , fans shouldn't expect the upcoming part of One-Punch Man Season 3 to look any better .

Considering how both parts of the season appear to have been produced under almost identical production guidelines, as evidenced by the same edited poster from Part 1 being reused to promote Part 2, there is little reason to expect an improvement. The fact remains that One-Punch Man was never given enough attention by the production committee from the start, as it never even had a permanent staff at Madhouse.

Had things been different, One-Punch Man , even under J.C. Staff, could have emerged as a series as great as, or even better than, Overgeared , which is being hailed as Crunchyroll's hottest Fall 2026 anime , delivering action that only a handful of anime can match. How are you feeling about Overgeared so far compared to releases like One-Punch Man ? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments.

articles.summary: No sign of improvising anywhere
articles.content:
While the fifth Toy Story gave us more insight into Jessie , it also gave us an insane Buzz Lightyear moment that was "heaven" for Tim Allen . The actor is known for his ad-libbing, both in his stand-up and in his sitcoms. Some of his best bits and impressions have made it on screen, and this goes for the toy-centric franchise as well. So naturally when the actor returned for the fifth movie, he saw an opportunity to improvise, but the Toy Story animators hated to see him coming.

The actor has been playing the character since the first Toy Story in 1995, and has given Buzz a specific voice that can be "deceptively hard to capture" for writers. So Allen gives the character a little something extra that has paid off in his favor, especially since we can thank the actor for an iconic moment:

It’s hard to imagine Toy Story without that moment. Though I can see how that would be frustrating for the animators. Ironically one wish that Allen had nearly came true. He has admitted that he wanted more Buzz, as he felt the character didn't have much in prior films. Allen has jokingly said this way people won’t remember “a fabric cowboy.”

However, this wasn’t the first time we’ve seen a multi-Lightyear performance. There was a moment in Toy Story 2 with several Space Ranger toys on the shelves in Al’s Toy Barn. Then we spent some time with an alternative Buzz who temporarily took our Buzz’s place. Though we hadn’t seen a multi-toy arc quite to this extent, which was everything Allen wanted it to be and more.

articles.title: Devil May Cry, Okami Director Reveals He Wants to Make a Castlevania Game
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Konami Legendary game developer Hideki Kamiya has had a hand in creating some of the medium's most iconic franchises, like Resident Evil, Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, Okami, and more. Now he wants to add one more beloved franchise to his CV: Castlevania. Speaking on his personal YouTube channel, Kamiya went on about possible companies he could […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Legendary game developer Hideki Kamiya has had a hand in creating some of the medium's most iconic franchises, like Resident Evil, Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, Okami, and more. Now he wants to add one more beloved franchise to his CV: Castlevania.

Speaking on his personal YouTube channel , Kamiya went on about possible companies he could possibly work with in the future. He started by saying Clovers, his independent studio that he formed in 2023, has no outside funding. As such, he wants to stay in the good graces of other publishers in hopes to collaborate with them and "keep doing interesting things," according to YouTube's automated transcription.

He called out Capcom, Nintendo, PlayStation ( after criticizing its scalper-friendly rollout of a special anniversary PS5 console ), and Konami, which prompted him to bring up two Konami games: the obscure hack-and-slash Getsu Fūma Den and the not-so-obscure Castlevania.

"I'll make a Castlevania," said Kamiya. "If we made it, it would be incredible, so please let us take the job. I am a bit busy right now, though."

He then fantasized about developing a Star Fox game with Koei Tecmo, a sequel to the scrolling shooter King's Knight with Square Enix, and another Kinnikuman: Muscle Tag Match with Bandai Namco, noting he would send out emails when he was done with the Okami sequel that was announced in 2024 .

Kamiya has praised Castlevania in the past, too. In an interview with Japanese magazine Famitsu in 2025, he said Castlevania was one of the top games that had inspired him the most. And when asked in a 2006 interview about what action game he holds in the highest regards (outside of ones he has worked on), he brought up the debut entry in the series and called it an "amazing action game."

"Back then when I played it, the amount of detail that went into it, I feel the creator must have had a clear vision of what he wanted to do," said Kamiya. "Even when I saw the weapon, it wasn't a gun or anything that you'd normally see in a game, it was a whip. Even the stages themselves were becoming a story, you can see the clock tower where Dracula is supposed to be off in the distance. As you progress through, you're actually going into the castle, through the catacombs and waterways, going up and going down. It feels like it's telling a story, there aren't any extraneous elements that are just sitting there. Everything is in its place, and the level of vision the designer had was impressive."

Konami has also been more open with its series as of late, too. This initiative has been most notably seen with Silent Hill, as Silent Hill: The Short Message , the Silent Hill 2 remake, Silent Hill f , Silent Hill: Townfall , and the upcoming remake of the original Silent Hill have all been led by studios outside of Konami. Silent Hill has also crossed over with other games like Dead by Daylight and Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly .

Other studios have also taken the reins of Castlevania, as it has had branded DLC in Dead by Daylight , Vampire Survivors , and Dead Cells . Evil Empire not only made Dead Cells ' Castlevania expansion, but it also developed Castlevania: Belmont's Curse , a full 2.5D Castlevania game.

Would you be more interested in a Castlevania game from Kamiya? Tell us in the comments.

articles.title: 'Twilight' Director Reveals Robert Pattinson Inspired James Bond Line in 2008 Film: "We Were Seeing the Future"

Catherine Hardwicke , who helmed 2008's Twilight , might as well have had a crystal ball on the set of the vampire romance film.

After it was revealed earlier this month that Robert Pattinson — who earned his breakout role as Edward Cullen in the blockbuster franchise — had been tapped as the new James Bond , fans were quick to point out that Twilight predicted his 007 casting nearly two decades ago.

In a recent interview on The Kyle Buchanan Show , Hardwicke recalled how that line and scene came about. "You guys have probably seen online where we have that [ Twilight ] scene where he [Eric] says, ‘Bond, James Bond,’ and then we cut to Rob," she said. "That’s the one scene where I was like, ‘Let’s put the sunglasses on that day,' and he got out of the car and he looked so suave that he inspired the line, ‘Bond, James Bond.’

The director added that Chon "kind of ad-libbed it, and it was kind of cool because we did think he looked like James Bond. So I guess we were seeing the future."

Fast forward to 2026 and Denis Villeneuve, who's helming the new 007 movie, and producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman, obviously thought Pattinson looked like Bond too . The Primetime actor is taking over the iconic role from Daniel Craig, who concluded his run with 2021’s No Time to Die .

Hardwicke also shared her reaction to the news that Pattinson would be going from having "the skin of a killer" to getting his license to kill. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

"I almost fell out of my bed," she quipped about the moment she learned about the casting. "I just didn’t think they were going to choose him because of The Batman and he’s so famous and they like to get the unknown [actor]. So I did almost fall out of the bed, and that is the same bed that Rob and Kristen [Stewart, who played Bella Swan in Twilight ] auditioned for the first time and did their kissing scene. So it was kind of bizarre. And he [Pattinson] fell out of the bed when he did the audition and landed on the floor, so it was kind of cool."

Hardwicke continued to praise The Batman actor's talents, adding, "He’s intense and interesting and has got a lot of stuff going on in there. He’s weird and he’s original. He does not fit the mold. He’s not afraid to say crazy shit, that’s what I love about it."

She said the actors who were initially auditioning “didn’t look like they’d been alive for almost 100 years and all this deep, soulful angst, existential crisis. They did not feel that kind of soulful.”

However, once Stewart and Pattinson did their chemistry read, the director knew he was the one because she felt “that electricity” between them.

articles.title: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie Settle Winery Lawsuit That Revealed Abuse Allegations
articles.summary: Brad Pitt has settled his legal battle with ex-wife Angelina Jolie over the sale of her stake in the couple's winery in France. Pitt sued Jolie in 2022, accusing her of selling her 50% share in Château Miraval to a subsidiary of Stoli, the Russian spirits company, without Pitt's approval. The litigation drew attention to […]
articles.content:
Brad Pitt has settled his legal battle with ex-wife Angelina Jolie over the sale of her stake in the couple's winery in France.

Pitt sued Jolie in 2022, accusing her of selling her 50% share in Château Miraval to a subsidiary of Stoli, the Russian spirits company, without Pitt's approval. The litigation drew attention to Jolie's allegation that Pitt abused her and the couple's children on a private plane in 2016, precipitating the couple's divorce. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-variety-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories 'Hyena,' Thriller Exec Produced by David Lynch, to Star Kiernan Shipka, D’Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, Edgar Ramírez and Rosemarie DeWitt Sofia Coppola Pays Tribute to Late Mother Eleanor Coppola at Paris Screening of ‘Making Marie Antoinette’ Hosted by Chanel and Mubi

“We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further," representatives for Jolie and Pitt said in a statement on Wednesday. "Any comments in media stories attributed to 'sources' are in fact not coming from either of us, or anyone close to us."

Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. Pitt has also sued Yuri Shefler, the Russian-born billionaire who owns the Stoli Group. That portion of the litigation is ongoing.

Pitt and Jolie bought the Miraval estate in 2008, and were married there in 2014. They invested tens of millions of dollars in the 1,300-acre property in order to turn Château Miraval into a profitable rosé brand.

Jolie filed for divorce in 2016, and the fate of the winery has been in dispute ever since. Pitt has argued that the company was his "passion," that he poured his energies into making it a success, and that Jolie has forced him into an unworkable arrangement with Stoli, a competitor. In a cross-complaint filed in 2022, Jolie accused Pitt attempting to seize control from her and of "looting" it for other ventures.

"Pitt is an actor, not a winemaker. He deals in illusions, not dirt and grapes," Jolie's lawyers wrote. "While he no doubt visited the vineyards to admire the work of the French laborers who actually made the business successful, Pitt is no vigneron." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[320,480],[300,250],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

According to her cross-complaint, Jolie initially planned to sell her half of the winery to Pitt. But in 2021, the deal fell apart. According to her, Pitt conditioned the buyout on her willingness to sign a non-disclosure agreement about the domestic abuse incident that led to their divorce.

The cross-complaint alleged that during a flight from France to the U.S., Pitt drunkenly grabbed her by the head and pushed her into a wall of the plane. The suit also claimed that Pitt lunged at one of the couple's children, poured beer on Jolie and the children as they tried to sleep, and then refused to let the family leave the plane for 20 minutes after it landed.

Her complaint alleged that Pitt "sought to use Château Miraval as leverage to coerce Jolie into keeping quiet about Pitt’s behavior. This new demand essentially imposed a poison pill, all but ensuring that no deal could ever be reached."

Rather than accept that condition, Jolie sold her stake to Stoli. She alleged that the couple had no agreement not to sell to a third party.

A judge denied Jolie's demurrer in November 2024, finding that Pitt's claims were adequately pled.

The parties have since been engaged in disputes over access to financial records and over jurisdictional issues. Pitt has accused Stoli and Shefler of attempting a "hostile takeover" of the wine business. In June, an appellate court revived Pitt's case against them, finding that Shefler, a Swiss resident, can be sued in California.

articles.title: King Crimson Original Drummer Michael Giles Dies at 84
articles.summary: Michael Giles, whose drumming on King Crimson’s legendary debut album brought fire and abandon to an already wild and innovative sound, has died, according to a post on the band’s website. No cause of death was announced; he was 84. “His extraordinary rhythmic imagination, musical sensitivity and highly inventive approach to drumming were fundamental to […]
articles.content:
Michael Giles, whose drumming on King Crimson ’s legendary debut album brought fire and abandon to an already wild and innovative sound, has died, according to a post on the band’s website. No cause of death was announced; he was 84.

“His extraordinary rhythmic imagination, musical sensitivity and highly inventive approach to drumming were fundamental to the band's pioneering sound,” the announcement reads in part. “Michael’s originality, musical curiosity and uncompromising commitment to creative freedom challenged conventions and inspired generations of musicians around the world. He leaves behind an extraordinary musical legacy, and his unique contribution to the evolution of progressive music will never be forgotten.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-variety-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Sofia Coppola Pays Tribute to Late Mother Eleanor Coppola at Paris Screening of ‘Making Marie Antoinette’ Hosted by Chanel and Mubi 'Hyena,' Thriller Exec Produced by David Lynch, to Star Kiernan Shipka, D’Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, Edgar Ramírez and Rosemarie DeWitt

Hailing from Bournemouth on England’s south coast — along with Crimson cofounders Robert Fripp and Greg Lake — Fripp and his brother Peter formed a group with Fripp in 1967. Calling themselves (naturally enough) Giles, Giles and Fripp, the trio released an album titled “The Cheerful Insanity of Giles, Giles and Fripp” the following year. The album laid the groundwork for King Crimson, which formed in 1968 with Fripp, vocalist/ bassist Lake, multi-instrumentalist Ian McDonald and lyricist Peter Sinfield.

Formed at the end of 1968, Crimson’s early concerts electrified the British rock scene, with the band being invited to open for the Rolling Stones at its massive concert in London’s Hyde Park in July of 1969. The band’s innovative sound, as captured on its debut album, “In the Court of the Crimson King,” combined rock, jazz, classical and avant-garde music into a concoction that many consider to be the first true progressive-rock album; certainly nothing like it had been heard during the rock era. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[320,480],[300,250],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Its influence was profound, and can be heard everywhere from the music of fellow prog-rock travelers Yes and Genesis as well as David Bowie, Roxy Music and countless later acolytes like Tool and the Mars Volta; its song “20 th Century Schizoid Man” was famously sampled by Kanye West on his 2010 single “Power.”

Giles’ wild drumming was key to the band’s first lineup, embellishing its classical-tinged sound with innovative, thunderous drum rolls and lightning-fast rhythms.

However, in a trend that would follow throughout Crimson’s long existence, this lineup was short-lived: By early 1970, McDonald, Lake and Giles had all left the band, although the latter two did contribute to the band’s second album, “In the Wake of Poseidon.”

Giles subsequently recorded an album with McDonald under the name McDonald and Giles (naturally enough), and over the years performed on recordings with an unusually diverse array of artists, including erstwhile bandmates Lake and Sinfield as well as Steve Winwood, Bryan Ferry, Leo Sayer, original Genesis guitarist Anthony Phillips, Kevin Ayers, Neil Sedaka, Yvonne Elliman, Andy Summers and the Penguin Cafe Orchestra.

He also released a solo album titled “Progress, Ghost Dance” with later Crimson member Jamie Muir and David Cunningham, and the Michael Giles MAD Band, which featured yet another Crimson alumnus, Keith Tippett.

He and several other alums united in 2002 to form the 21st Century Schizoid Band, which toured performing the band's early repertoire.

He is survived by his five children, Tina, Amanda, William, Rosie and Oliver, several grandchildren, his sister Marion and brother Peter.

articles.title: 5 Deadly Batman Golden Age Villains Who Are Bigger Threats Today Than When They Debuted
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of DC Comics Batman has been around longer than almost any other superhero, debuting in 1939, around the same time as Superman, Namor the Sub-Mariner, and Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch. Batman started out fighting some villains who are still around today, although as time passed, these villains changed as well. Batman has also changed over the […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Batman has been around longer than almost any other superhero, debuting in 1939, around the same time as Superman, Namor the Sub-Mariner, and Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch. Batman started out fighting some villains who are still around today, although as time passed, these villains changed as well. Batman has also changed over the years, as has his sidekick Robin, but in reality, Batman has always been the same hero in comics, even when he became more comical and kitschy in the 1960s and early 1970s. However, when it comes to his villains, the ideas of bad guys in the 1940s are not the same as they were in the 1980s, when villains needed to be more than just generic thieves.

The villain in Batman #1 was none other than the Joker, making his main villain as old as Batman himself. This was a big deal because heroes like Superman faced hardly any of their best-known villains in their first few years. Bob Kane and Bill Finger had their finger on what made a villain great, and even though these bad guys have changed over the years, the genesis for their greatness was there from the start.

Clayface is more popular than ever thanks to the 2026 DCU horror movie , and the character in this movie is a mix of the original Golden Age Clayface, Basil Karlo, and the one better known today, Matt Hagen. However, Karlo was nothing like the Clayface fans know today because he wasn't a shapeshifter, and he didn't have any superpowers at all. Clayface debuted in Detective Comics #40 (1940) by Bill Finger and Bob Kane.

The first Clayface was Basil Karlo, a washed-up actor who murdered performers working on a remake of his greatest movie. He was just a killer who wore a mask, and it was up to Batman to figure out who he was and stop him. This all changed when Matt Hagen debuted in Detective Comics #298 (1961) by Bill Finger and Sheldon Moldoff. He ended up finding a pool of protoplasm that gave him his shape-shifting powers. That is the version of Clayface that still exists today, and he is nothing like the original Clayface.

The Scarecrow debuted in World's Finest Comics #3 (1941) by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. Jonathan Crane enjoyed frightening birds as a boy and grew up to teach the psychology of fear at Gotham University, where colleagues mocked his shabby clothes because he spent his money on rare old books. He decided money earned respect and ran fear like a protection racket, calling himself the Scarecrow, and wearing a costume that signified poverty and fear. He used a gun to create fear as he became a thief.

This all changed when Gardner Fox and Sheldon Moldoff brought him back in Batman #189 (1966), and this was where Scarecrow's fear toxin was introduced for the first time. His actual origin wasn't even told until Batman Annual #19 (1995), where he was shown to use fear gas to drive his mentor to suicide, and then he took his job. Today, Scarecrow is known for his fear toxin , which he uses to get what he wants, but this was not anything like his first appearances in the Golden Age, other than the costume.

Two-Face debuted in Detective Comics #66 (1942) by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. In his first appearance, he was Harvey "Apollo" Kent, although his name was changed from Kent to Dent in 1948 because DC didn't want him to share a surname with Clark Kent. The first appearance really played into the classic horror movies Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde and The Phantom of the Opera . His origin hasn't changed at all since his Golden Age introduction.

After mob boss Moroni threw acid at him, Harvey scratched one side of Moroni's double-headed silver dollar, flipped it, and turned to crime when the scarred side came up. This just turned him into a straight-up villain. However, things changed drastically in later years when his fall from being a great district attorney was told in Batman: Year One , Batman: The Long Halloween , and Batman Annual #14 (1990), where his dissociative disorder made him much more sympathetic than his original depiction.

The Penguin debuted in Detective Comics #58 (1941) by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. In his debut, he posed as an art dealer named Mr. Boniface, smuggled stolen paintings out of a gallery inside an umbrella, and soon took over the rackets in Gotham City. He framed Batman by knocking him out at a robbery scene, and Batman called Robin with a radio hidden in his heel. The Penguin still escaped, and the story continued into the next issue. In these early appearances, he was an almost comical villain no one could take seriously.

The Cobblepot surname came later, from the Batman newspaper strip, which is where he became a little more serious of a villain. However, he remained comical in his 1960s Batman television series appearances, even more so than Batman's other villains. In 1992, Tim Burton's Batman Returns turned Penguin into a violent monster, and the more recent HBO series saw Colin Farrell turn Penguin into a much more dangerous, cunning villain . Penguin today is no longer a joke by any measure, much more respected than his Golden Age persona.

The Joker was Batman's villain in Batman #1 (1940) by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. In this issue, the Joker was a ruthless thief and had no problem killing to complete his heists. He wasn't the more manic version that would appear years later. The issue almost killed him off to make him a one-and-done, but it was left open-ended so he could return later. This version of the murderous thief was changed in the 1950s when he was given a new origin as the Red Hood, and this is where he received his acid-chemical vat origin.

In the 1970s, he was changed again to return to his more murderous traits, which was when Batman started getting darker as well, moving away from the more kitschy 1960s television show. By 1988's The Killing Joke , the Joker was thrust into the role of one of the deadliest Batman villains of all time. An attempt to explain all of this came in Three Jokers , which claimed there were three different Jokers throughout history. However, going from a villain who was supposed to die in his first appearance to becoming Batman's greatest villain is the biggest change of all.

Which Golden Age Batman villains do you think improved most from the changes to them over the years? Let us know your favorites in the comments below.

articles.title: Paper Tiger Ending Explained, Including What James Gray Told Us About Those Final Scenes
articles.summary: What happened and what it means for Irwin's family.
articles.content:
To say that Paper Tiger had me stressed would be an understatement. James Gray's crime drama, which just arrived on the 2026 movie schedule , had me on the edge of my seat throughout, and then reeling from those final scenes. I want to get into what happened at the end of the movie, and what the writer/director told us about it. I can't do that without 🛑 MAJOR spoilers from the Adam Driver movie - if you haven't seen Paper Tiger and have somehow wandered into this article, now's your chance to leave! Be sure to catch it in theaters or wait until it's available on streaming .

It was looking like there really wouldn't be any way out of the danger Irwin ( Miles Teller ), his brother Gary ( Adam Driver ) and his family were in. Gary, as it turned out, wasn't the kind of cop who would cross major ethical lines by working with the Russian mob - at least not for any kind of job that isn't above board. When money wasn't going to be enough to satisfy Simeon Bogoyavich (Victor Ptak), and Gary wasn't willing to work with him, the only way to make things right was for Gary to accept the terms of Simeon's deal: his life in exchange for his brother's (and his family's) safety. That was Simeon's price, and Gary agreed to pay it.

After seeing his brother one last time at Scott's birthday party, Gary lies and says he's leaving the country, assuring Irwin things are going to be ok and gifting him his car. We see him get emotional when he's by himself in his rental car, which I interpret as him accepting his fate, as terrible as it is.

At Irwin's house, his wife Hester (Scarlett Johansson) has snuck off to have surgery on her brain tumor. She's last seen blowing a kiss to her husband and kids, who are still asleep. Later that morning, Scott is helping Ben study, and Irwin listens to a message about job opportunities now that his and his brother's consulting business is registered. The tone is uplifting in the Pearl house, despite what we know. Does this mean that everything is going to be ok, and the Russian mob boss will keep his end of the deal now that Gary is dead?

In the final scene within the Pearl house, they don't yet know about Hester's situation, though it seems unlikely that she'll keep that a secret for long. This family may be out of the woods with this Russian mob situation, but that doesn't mean everything will be perfect in the coming weeks and months. As Gray put it:

The more I think about Paper Tiger 's ending, the more this makes sense to me and adds to my overall satisfaction to this suspenseful and emotional film. Hester's tumor is nobody's doing, just the tragic nature of life, unfair though it may be. So much of what transpired in the film had to do with choices and actions, but in the case of Hester, it's just the cards she was dealt, and she and her family will have to face that.

articles.content:
NBC has a Thanksgiving Week present for advertisers scheduled to appear in the now-postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

The network plans to run commercials from sponsors of the event twice this week — once when the 2026 parade airs on Saturday and once on Thursday, when the network will run a repeat of last year's Macy's extravaganza. In short, Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade advertisers get two runs on the network for ther price of one. The details were confirmed by an NBC spokesperson. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-variety-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories 'Hyena,' Thriller Exec Produced by David Lynch, to Star Kiernan Shipka, D’Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, Edgar Ramírez and Rosemarie DeWitt Sofia Coppola Pays Tribute to Late Mother Eleanor Coppola at Paris Screening of ‘Making Marie Antoinette’ Hosted by Chanel and Mubi

Macy's and NBC decided to postpone the parade to Saturday, November 28, citing extreme wind conditions and inclement weather expected on Thursday. Many of the signature balloons used in the parade cannot be controlled properly during high wind speeds. The network said it is "committed to ensuring this remains a high-priority opportunity for our clients with both the reach and scale of tomorrow's re-airing and the original live telecast on Saturday."

NBC has many reasons to keep advertisers in the parade happy. The cost of a 30-second commercial in the parade is up 15% to 20% over last year , according to Guideline, a tracker of ad spending, when NBC was able to charge between $900,000 and $1 million per unit. Those figures would indicate that a 30-second spot in the 2026 parade could cost between$1.03 million and $1.2 million. Ad spend on the event is pacing about 25% to 30% ahead of last year, according to Guideline. The parade snared more than $88.7 million in ads last year, the company says.

The parade is also part of a time-honored lineup that includes the National Dog Show and a primetime NFL game. The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade telecast was the opening event in a extended schedule of holiday programs that the network uses to lure marketers eager to court holiday shoppers. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[320,480],[300,250],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Geico had plans to run a two-minute commercial that uses stop-motion animation featuring many of its trademark characters, such as the Geico Gecko. Starbucks had signed on to promote a new holiday album, “The Holiday Blend,” and is the sponsor of a takeover of an NBC livestream of the parade on TikTok.

NBC isn't the first TV network to confront delays tied to a massive live event. CBS in 2013 gave some of the advertisers in that year's Super Bowl an extra run of their commercials after a 35-minute power outage brought a game between the Baltimore Ravens and the San Francisco 49'ers. articles.title: 3 Anime to Watch If You're Waiting for Re:Zero Season 5
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of White Fox Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World– is easily one of the biggest anime on Crunchyroll, and it continues to get more popular thanks to its sequel seasons. 2026 was a huge year for fans since the anime not only commemorated its 10th anniversary, but also aired its Season 4 in two cours. Written by Tappei Nagatsuki, […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World – is easily one of the biggest anime on Crunchyroll, and it continues to get more popular thanks to its sequel seasons. 2026 was a huge year for fans since the anime not only commemorated its 10th anniversary , but also aired its Season 4 in two cours. Written by Tappei Nagatsuki, Re:Zero is one of the most intense dark fantasies that doesn't shy away from showing the brutalities of the world Subaru is forced to live in. The fourth season was one of the biggest anime of the year as it continues Subaru's gruesome journey where he is forced to witness his friends die in gruesome ways, forcing him to realize his own weakness.

The latest season ended on a massive cliffhanger as it wraps up the Pleiades Watchtower storyline. Luckily, the anime has already confirmed a fifth season that will follow Subaru's journey to the Vollachian Empire. The story will continue to be more intense from here on out, and the creator has confirmed that fans can expect new encounters along the way. The fifth season hasn't shared a release window yet, so there's no guarantee how long we have to wait for the anime's return. In the meantime, if you're looking for more anime to watch, then you'll definitely love these three as a fan of Re:Zero .

Steins;Gate is one of the highest-rated psychological anime of all time. First released as a visual novel in 2009, the franchise would receive an anime adaptation in 2011 that helped spread this incredible story all across the world. As a time-travel anime involving deep emotional connections and the consequences of such a power, Steins;Gate is highly addictive, especially if you love layers of mysteries.

At first, the prospect of time travel might seem like an exciting breakthrough, but it soon becomes clear through cycles of psychological torment that not everything is as it seems on the surface. The same animation studio behind Re:Zero also worked on Steins;Gate , and both stories focus on time-travelling protagonists. While both stories have different narrative structures, they focus on the traumatizing consequences for the protagonists and their loved ones as the repeating tragedies cost them their sanity.

Anime shows centering around the themes of time travel or time loops are scarce, but whenever such a story is released, it immediately piques viewers’ interest. The reason this anime stands out is thanks to the premiere episode that contains just the right amount of mystery and action to hook viewers, but doesn't answer all the questions right away. The anime wraps up the story in just 25 episodes, which is significantly less compared to the 139 chapters of the manga. However, since the manga chapters are rather short, the anime did manage to cover the entire story with fast pacing and minor cuts from the original.

Thanks to the quick pacing, each episode keeps the viewers on the edge of their seats as they look forward to what’s going to happen next. The story centers around Shinpei Ajiro, who returns to his hometown after the sudden death of his childhood friend. He stumbles upon the dangers lurking in the seemingly peaceful island that might be related to the recent tragedy. Amid all the chaos and confusion, he realizes he has the power to time loop after he dies, which is pretty much the same as the ability Subaru has.

While Puella Magi Madoka Magica isn't an isekai series and it doesn't have a protagonist who can time travel, fans of Re:Zero will love this dark fantasy nonetheless. This acclaimed fantasy classic on Crunchyroll is a surprisingly gruesome psychological thriller that hides behind its cheerful and bright animation style. With one glance at the anime and the adorable magical girls, no one could ever imagine the true horrors awaiting viewers. This award-winning show premiered its anime series in 2011 before returning with sequel movies in 2012 and 2013 .

This original story centers around Madoka Kaname and Sayaka Miki, two middle school girls whose ordinary lives take drastic turns after encountering Kyuubey, a mysterious magical familiar. While the girls accept the offer to gain magical powers, they never realize it comes with a steep price. Before they knew it, Kyuubey forces them into a no-win systematic trap where they must do whatever they can to end the suffering of all the magical girls who fell for the brutal trap.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that shares similar vibes to Re:Zero ? Let us know in the comments below.

articles.title: 21 Years Later, Constantine Director Is Still Mad About The Movie's R-Rating & Recalls The MPAA's Bizarre Reasoning
articles.summary: IMAGE COURTESY OF WARNER BROS. Francis Lawrence did everything he could to keep 2005's Constantine PG-13, and it was all to no avail. "If I knew we were going to get an R, I would have made an R-rated movie," he told Kevin McCarthy on the On Film podcast (as transcribed by Dread Central). Nowadays, the mere fact of lead […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Francis Lawrence did everything he could to keep 2005's Constantine PG-13, and it was all to no avail. "If I knew we were going to get an R, I would have made an R-rated movie," he told Kevin McCarthy on the On Film podcast (as transcribed by Dread Central ). Nowadays, the mere fact of lead character John Constantine being a smoker might automatically bump up the rating a bit, but the MPAA hadn't gotten there yet in 2005. As was so often the case, they rendered a subjective judgment; one not subject to appeal because they didn't use objective criteria to back it up.

"They decided that the movie was too intense and there’s nothing we could do to it to change their minds into a PG-13," recalls Lawrence. When he tried arguing that the movie was no more violent than The Lord of the Rings , they gave the bewildering response, "Yes, but elves and orcs are not real. But people believe angels and demons are."

There's a lot to unpack with that statement about angels and demons. Like, how many religious believers think angels and demons literally look like human beings with wings? If people believe in angels and demons, don't they already believe in a war in Heaven that created evil, and is/was more violent than anything Constantine shows? Could the script have made them Hindu avatars, specifying that they're not the kind of angels Christians believe in? It's not uncommon for censors in the U.S. to have a religious bias — the PMRC infamously used to slap the "Explicit lyrics" label on albums like Danzig's Lucifuge that didn't have any profanity, but mentioned demons.

In the years since, of course, we've seen Matt Ryan's more comic-accurate John Constantine take on angels and demons on network TV. DC Studios under James Gunn were looking at rebooting the character , and probably would have aimed for a PG-13 as well. Now that Gunn's out, and David Ellison is looking to push A-listers, a Keanu Reeves-led sequel to Constantine 2005, from the director of The Hunger Games , is probably looking better and better. Having learned his lesson the first time, though, Lawrence is just going to go for an R rating. Check out the full podcast below:

Lawrence isn't the first DC director to have to deal with the ratings board — Zack Snyder's director's cuts of both Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice and Justice League were rated R, but only after PG-13 theatrical cuts failed to do the numbers they needed. With a new guiding principle in place that superheroes need to be fun for the whole family , and new boss Jeremy Latcham explicitly and overtly a man of faith, Constantine 2 might run into some trouble. Although with TV's The Chosen depicting angel warriors in its Jesus story, and Mel Gibson's The Resurrection of the Christ likely to depict angels and demons, we may have hit a point of normalization for that sort of imagery, for people who do and don't believe.
